title: Plugin
description: An installed plugin: external package contributing commands, skills, agents, hooks and permissions.

source.description: npm package, git URL or local path the plugin came from.

commands.description: Command names contributed by the plugin.

skills.description: Skill names contributed by the plugin.

agents.description: Agent names contributed by the plugin.

event.description: Event type or wildcard the hook listens for (see event-manifest.json).

hooks.description: Event hooks run by the plugin.

permissions.description: Permissions requested by the plugin at install time.
